correctness.rationale: The classical perimeter optimizer/Reinhardt correspondence and the explicit cyclotomic criterion reduce n=9 to 128 odd-part compositions. Independent exact division by Phi_18=z^6-z^3+1 leaves exactly [(3)^3] and [(1)^9]. For [(3)^3], an equilateral triangle of side one has three congruent polygonal caps, each of area (3/2)sin(pi/9)-sqrt(3)/4; hence A_tri=9sin(pi/9)/2-sqrt(3)/2. The regular diameter-one nonagon has circumradius 1/(2cos(pi/18)) and A_reg=9sin^2(pi/18)cot(pi/9). Elementary trigonometry gives gap=(sqrt(3)-9tan(pi/18))/2. Taking t=1/(3sqrt(3)), tan(3 arctan t)=10sqrt(3)/27>tan(pi/6), proving tan(pi/18)<t. Independent 80-digit coordinate shoelace, side and diameter calculations corroborate the formulas.
residual_risks: The universal perimeter-maximizer characterization is imported from classical published work; the finite check alone cannot establish it.
Numerical coordinate checks support but do not replace the elementary exact cap and trigonometric proof.

value.rationale: For nine sides the maximum-perimeter fixed-diameter problem first has multiple odd-sided optimizer shapes, so area is a natural secondary geometric invariant. The theorem determines the complete exact area spectrum and positive separation between the two optimizers, resolving a genuine tie-breaking question. It is narrow and elementary once the known class count is available, but the exact nonregular area is a mathematically specific natural fact not supplied by the inspected class counts or the global odd-area theorem.
residual_risks: No claim of a new global area maximum, general n-spectrum, or deep extension of Reinhardt classification.
Small-side exact evaluation can have modest standalone reach; its natural completeness for n=9 is the specific value argument.

limitations: The Reinhardt characterization and the n<30 periodicity are established published prerequisites; their classification is not newly proved.

The 2011 primary enumeration study could be assessed only from abstract and bibliography because open-access retrieval failed and authorized institutional access reported disconnected VPN; no whole-document noncoverage is claimed.
